title: Coalition transport permutation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $A$ and $B$ be subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with equal cardinality. There is a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ obtained by extending a bijection between $A$ and $B$.
